tools.name: lookup
tools.description:
Find the entities that go by a name, to fill a reference input of another tool.

Use when: you know the name of an entity where a tool needs a reference. Names are matched whole, ignoring case, against main, alternative and hidden names; each name gets its candidates ranked, best first, and only those of the class that the input in for takes (matches of other classes are counted in texts[].excluded). Pass the id or alias of a candidate as the reference, never a guess: when a name has several candidates, facts tell them apart.

text.description: A name, or a list of at most 50 names, each looked up on its own.

for.description: The input the entity is for, as <tool>.<input> (<tool>._entity for the entity of an entity view): only candidates of the class that input takes are listed.
